option_relations.rationale: Dominant dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa is a broader category that includes pruritic papular epidermolysis bullosa.

Dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (particularly DEB pruriginosa) is a broader category that includes pruritic papular epidermolysis bullosa, as DEB pruriginosa is often used interchangeably or as a specific presentation of pruritic papular EB.
Epidermolysis bullosa pruriginosa (EBP) is clinically equivalent to pruritic papular epidermolysis bullosa.
Recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa is a broader category that includes pruritic papular epidermolysis bullosa, although the vignette specifies a dominant variant.
